utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Hi there. How has the week been for you?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: I've been having thorts about killing myslef. Not sure how to explain it. I know its spelled wrong, I'm just typing how I talk sometimes. It's been on my mind a lot lately.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: It sounds like a difficult week. What kinds of activities have you been filling your time with?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Not much. I feel like hurtin mysef sometimes. Like I'm at the end of my rope and I can't realy see any way foreward right now. Things feel completely hopeless.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Hopelessness can make everything feel heavier. What's been contributing to that feeling?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Everything just. I wish I wasnt here. No reson to keep going like this. I just feel liek theer is no point in living.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Those feelings of purposelessness are something we can work on together in therapy. Have you tried the mood tracking app we discussed?
